title: SPAC TERMINAL
text:
In the late ‘80s, digital wasn’t just a kooky sci-fi fantasy anymore, it was really becoming the new systems reality. ABB was connecting these digital dots with the SPAC feeder terminal in the SPACOM system.

The SPAC terminals digitally integrated multiple protection and control functions into a single compact unit instead of using separate relays for each function. This enabled smarter protection and control and was a pioneering solution in the market.
funFact: ‘80s office life often meant battling a copier that always seemed to jam at the very worst time. That was before 1987’s Windows 2.0 kicked off digital documents. Goodbye paper chaos, hello file sharing.
